metrics.rationale: No network request is justified before a supported activation need; instrumentation for this invariant has not been captured on identified v0.17/v0.18 subjects, so the count remains unproven rather than assumed zero.
metrics.intentional_update_procedure: Capture a deterministic request log on exact identified VSIX/host subjects, review it as a correctness contract, then promote to blocking with an absolute ceiling of zero; any later update requires a reviewed activation/network contract change plus fresh baseline evidence.

metrics.rationale: Activation-to-commit wall time is a high-signal client cost envelope, but no repeatable distribution exists yet for identified previous-public and candidate VSIX subjects, so no threshold may be manufactured.
metrics.intentional_update_procedure: Record a bounded repeatable distribution across the #7868 scenario matrix on minimum-supported and current-stable hosts; set an advisory relative regression ratio from that distribution and promote to blocking only after noise/repeatability review.

metrics.rationale: Extension-host RSS cannot be reliably attributed to this extension inside the shared host process, so it stays informational and must never become a threshold gate; single observations are especially noisy.
metrics.intentional_update_procedure: Keep informational unless a reviewed attribution mechanism isolates extension-owned memory; reclassification requires new instrument evidence, an owner, and a deliberate policy-class change in this record.
